name: @sdef/specification
description: Software Definition Exchange Format (S.DEF) specification and protocol schema

scripts.generate: bun run generate:schema && bun run generate:proposals
scripts.generate:schema: bun run generate:schema:json & bun run generate:schema:md & wait
scripts.format: bun run format:docs && bun run format:schema
scripts.check: bun run check:schema && bun run check:docs && bun run check:proposals
scripts.check:schema: bun run check:schema:ts && bun run check:schema:json && bun run check:schema:examples && bun run check:schema:md
scripts.prep: bun run check:schema:ts && bun run generate && bun run check:docs && bun run check:proposals && bun run format
